content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Current Limitations ## slug: evbuilder-current-limitations ## seoTitle: Current Limitations ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End * The {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} is not optimized for mobile use. * The {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} does not save as you work. If you lose connection to {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} or refresh your page before you save, the data is lost. * Custom primary and background colors will not appear in the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}}, even though they appear on the published {{variable.Object_Event}}’s webpage. * The {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} is designed to work primarily with the new Dynamic UI. * Users can edit existing {{variable.Object_Event}}s with any UI from the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} and maintain the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s original UI. However, the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} will show the {{variable.Object_Event}} as if the user were using the Dynamic UI, which will differ from the published site. * Users cannot change an {{variable.Object_Event}} to one of the older UI options from the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}}. Instead, users must select the UI from the picklist on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record.
